name: Asset register to invoice reconciliation
summary: When new equipment, transfers or retirements must reach the reporting pack, the asset accountant gets a proposed register update matched to purchase records, commissioning evidence and the ledger, with duplicate IDs, unmatched invoices and uncertain in-service dates listed.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the work of energy businesses, and its own rules for prepared work: fixed inputs that stop on a mismatch, a person who confirms identity and a person who approves treatment, and nothing entered until they do.
